goal_title: Add VR interactive controls to artifacts that currently only display
why: Many artifacts across the project render but can't be poked. Their @identity blocks explicitly say 'slider_horizontal [missing]' etc. This is the 'dioramas, not instruments' problem named by multiple audits. Adding sliders/buttons to the most important artifacts converts passive observation into embodied parameter exploration.
success_criteria: Procgen artifacts (mutation_rate, percolation threshold) have sliders
Forces artifacts have applicable parameter controls
Noise artifacts have octave + amplitude sliders
ML artifacts have learning-rate / population sliders
Each addition follows the slider_horizontal pattern from turing_pattern_generator

tasks.title: Add sliders to PG_Genetic_Evolution artifacts
tasks.spec: Using the RackTemplates.create_panel pattern from commons/audio/rack_templates/RackTemplates.gd (see turing_pattern_generator.gd for example usage), add mutation_rate and population_size sliders to the PG_Genetic_Evolution anchor artifact. Panel should be tilted toward player.

tasks.title: Add slider to PG_Percolation_Network
tasks.spec: Percolation probability threshold slider — the whole point of the map is feeling the phase transition. Find the percolation artifact and attach a slider_horizontal driving probability.

tasks.title: Add octave + amplitude sliders to noise artifacts
tasks.spec: Perlin/simplex artifacts should let the player feel what octaves do. Add two sliders per anchor noise artifact following the Rams-plate pattern.

tasks.title: Add force-magnitude slider to ForcesFoundations Newton artifacts
tasks.spec: example_2_1/2/3/4 should each have a force/mass/gravity slider as applicable.

tasks.title: Add learning-rate slider to ML_Gradient_Landscape
tasks.spec: The gradient descent visualization becomes pedagogical only when the player can feel how learning rate affects convergence. Add the slider.
